conf.description: F5 BIG-IP ASM / Advanced WAF attack-event / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: f5-bigip-asm / attack-event / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (F5 BIG-IP integration (f5_bigip), log data stream (ASM JSON branch)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
